limits.detail: Astra v2 does not provide the accepted legacy agent_type spawn contract. Protected child configuration, actual lineage and peer/context-control isolation are not established. Tagged default-role overrides do not supply the required native-delegation disable. The alternative thread/fork proposal awaits manager revalidation; it is neither implemented nor launched.

No complete Curator bootstrap, confirmed native manager handoff, full generic/complex/extra-complex teams, identical isolated solver inputs, native owner publication, adversarial process/tool confinement or final NP reconciliation has passed.

The complete accepted native input-delivery/follow-up/conflict/reconciliation event mapping and resume semantics remain incomplete pending the native-route redesign. Legacy-shaped synthetic event fixtures cannot certify actual Astra v2 behavior.

Bound native sessions retain their logical capacity through readiness, idle, interruption and failure. A supported trusted observation of native slot release and enforceable dispatch/work bounds are still required; coordinator counters do not enforce a native spawn cap.
